from collections import Counter

            g=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
            c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
            G[k]=(g,c)
    return G

import numpy as np, itertools, os, re
from collections import Counter

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def rays(pts,H,W,dirs,exclude=None):
    exclude=exclude or set()
    o=np.zeros((H,W),int)
    for p in pts:
        for (dr,dc) in dirs:
            i,j=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
            while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W:
                o[i,j]+=1
                i+=dr;j+=dc
    for p in exclude: o[p]=0
    return o

# For each demo, find the best ray set minimizing symmetric difference; inspect top candidates' diffs to see structure
for k in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    g=np.array(gi); H,W=g.shape
    bg=Counter(g.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=sorted([(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i,j]!=bg])
    best=[]
    D4=[(a,b) for a in range(-4,5) for b in range(-4,5) if abs(a)+abs(b)<=4 and (a,b)!=(0,0)]
    for n in range(1,6):
        for subset in itertools.combinations(D4,n):
            o=rays(pts,H,W,set(subset))
            diff=int(np.abs(o.astype(int)-go.astype(int)).sum())
            best.append((diff,o.copy(),subset))
    best.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    print(k,'best:',best[0][0],'n=',len(best[0][2]))
    for b in best[:1]:
        # check whether prediction is a superset/subset of output
        pred=b[1]; exp=go.astype(bool)
        only_pred=int(((pred==1)&(~exp)).sum()); only_exp=int(((exp)&(pred==0)).sum())
        print('  only-pred cells:',only_pred,'only-exp cells:',only_exp)

d1=(2,3); d2=(4,6)

    rem=[x for x in S if (cover(set(S)-{x}))>=T]

def analyze(demo):
    gi,go=demo
    b=bgc(gi); ms=[(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=b]
    rs,cs=zip(*ms); d=min(abs(rs[i]-rs[j]) for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1,3))
    dr=abs(ms[1][0]-ms[0][0])/d if False else None
    # marker line direction
    v=(ms[1][0]-ms[0][0], ms[1][1]-ms[0][1]); dd=gcd(v[0],v[1])
    v=(v[0]//dd, v[1]//dd)
    mc=ms[1]; mr=mc[0]
    # full rows in output
    fullrows=[r for r,row in enumerate(go) if all(x==go[r][0] for x in row)]
    band=[r for r in range(len(go)) if not (r in fullrows or r in [m[0] for m in ms])]
    return gi,go,b,ms,v,mr,fullrows,band

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def f(g):
    gi=np.array(g); H,W=gi.shape
    cnt=Counter(int(x) for row in gi for x in row)
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    singles=[(int(r),int(c),v) for r,c,v in zip(*np.where(np.isin(gi,np.array(list(cnt)) if False else [x for x in cnt])))] if False else None
    # proper: find all non-bg colors, for each pixel check 4-neighbor isolation
    isol=[]
    for v in cnt:
        if v==bg: continue
        rs,cs=np.where(gi==v)
        for r,c in zip(rs.tolist(),cs.tolist()):
            nb=[gi[r+dy][c+dx] if 0<=r+dy<H and 0<=c+dx<W else -1 for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))]
            if all(x!=v for x in nb):
                isol.append((r,c,v))
    # pick color whose isolated pixels span the largest area
    from collections import defaultdict
    by=defaultdict(list)
    for s in isol: by[s[2]].append(s)
    pick=None; a=-1
    def aa(ss): return (max(p[0] for p in ss)-min(p[0] for p in ss)+1)*(max(p[1] for p in ss)-min(p[1] for p in ss)+1)
    for v,ss in by.items():
        a_=aa(ss)
        if a_<a: pass
        if a_>a: a,a_,pick=a_,a_,v
    ss=by[pick]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in ss); c0=min(p[1] for p in ss); r1=max(p[0] for p in ss); c1=max(p[1] for p in ss)
    out=[[int(gi[r][c]) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out[0][0]=out[0][-1]=out[-1][0]=out[-1][-1]=pick
    return out

import numpy as np, os, glob, re, collections
def load():
    G={}
    for fp in glob.glob(os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
        t=open(fp).read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Hypothesis: input is a periodic tiling (in one direction); output = one period.
for p in range(1,9):
    ia=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); ob=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    H,W=ia.shape; oh,ow=ob.shape
    # check if ia[:oh,:ow]==ob and whether input is periodic with period oh or ow
    ok_row = np.array_equal(ia[:oh,:ow], ob)
    per_r = all(np.array_equal(ia[r,:] , ia[r%oh,:]) for r in range(H)) if oh<H else None
    per_c = all(np.array_equal(ia[:,c], ia[:,c%ow]) for c in range(W)) if ow<W else None
    print(p, 'crop==out',ok_row,'period_rows',per_r,'period_cols',per_c)
